acceptance_predicates.description: Public asb config, provider-catalog, and provider-plan command routes and help/completion entries are absent.
ProviderSelection types, files, schemas, and --provider-selection inputs are removed from normal product interfaces.
No normal CLI or TUI route reads or writes XDG/user-home provider configuration.
Legacy invocations receive an actionable typed migration message that names setup --output.

definition_of_done: The explicit setup configuration is the only public provider/model selection authority.

outputs.description: Removed legacy command and selection interfaces with migration diagnostics.

gates.description: CLI/help/schema/source audit and negative integration tests prove retirement is complete.
